meaning:
A man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, only mentioned at Exo.6.25
§ Putiel = "afflicted of God"
father of the wife of Eleazar, the son of Aaron

elsewhere.note: Eleazar Aaron’s son took one of the daughters of Putiel as his wife; and she bore him Phinehas. These are the heads of the fathers’ houses of the Levites…
